question: In relation to Economic Reforms since 1991, New Industrial Policy was announced in:
solution:
The correct answer is** ****July 1991.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **New Industrial Policy was announced on Mon Jul 01 1991:**

 
 
• The New Industrial Policy of 1991 was a significant economic reform introduced to liberalize the Indian economy and reduce government control over industries.
 
• This policy aimed to remove barriers to foreign investment, reduce the public sector's dominance, and promote competition in the market.
 
• Key measures included the abolition of industrial licensing for most industries, reduction of import tariffs, and deregulation of the industrial sector.
 
• The policy marked a shift from a planned economy towards a more market-oriented economy, facilitating greater efficiency and productivity.
